caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers viewed from an angle, showing the front and one side. The chest is predominantly brown, representing a wood texture, and is decorated with intricate floral and geometric patterns in red, blue, and black. The front of the chest has three main rectangular sections on the top, above three horizontal drawers; each section contains detailed symmetrical designs. The central upper section features a circular motif with additional surrounding patterns. Below the decorated panels, there are three labeled drawers, each with two dark round handles. The foremost horizontal panel above the drawers bears the text “MARY PEASE” in black capital letters, separated by two red floral elements. The side panel also has a bordered design with rectangular shapes outlined in dark and red lines. The chest sits on four short legs, and the background is a plain off-white or beige color with some visible texture or discoloration.
title: Hadley Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
